# Shapeshift Forms

The Druid's `shift <form>` beast shapes. While shifted you fight in melee with the form's natural weapons (×STR) and **cannot cast** — `revert` to your own shape to use magic.

| Form | Lvl | Melee | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bear | 1 | 14–26 | A hulking brown bear — all muscle, claws, and bad intentions. |
| Dire Wolf | 3 | 11–23 | A lean grey dire wolf with a punishing, worrying bite. |
| Panther | 6 | 16–34 | A coiled black panther — fast, silent, and lethal. |
